author: cskiraly
content:
Triggered by some work on how we recover and serve blobs in sparse blobpool, I've also worked on optimizations in the underlying libraries: `go-eth-kzg` and `c-kzg-4844`.

I've started with the Reed Solomon part, but then also extended to the KZG part. Headline results are below. Most changes are already pushed as PRs, a few I still have to push. I'm not saying we should adopt this as it needs quite some critical review (if not audit), but there is definitely some space for improvement within the limits of our current spec. Reviews are welcome!
